div.div:
Verified gaps / partial integration
1. Runtime auth is custom HS256 JWT while target architecture names Supabase Auth. 2. No executable RLS setup was found; app-level ownership/scope filters are the active boundary.
3. Generic build_context_pack(), HITLAuditLog / route_tool_call(), and MonitoringAlert are library/test surfaces, not wired into the conversation path. 4. Conversation retention is still TBD; the non-stream endpoint persists and returns analysis.
